reports.standfirst: A late goal gave Fulham a 1-0 victory at Coventry City, the Cottagers' first away win of the season.
reports.account: Bobby Thomas went off injured on the hour for Coventry. Stephen Mfuni's header from inside the six-yard box, 19 minutes from time, was saved by Bernd Leno. The winner came with 10 minutes left, Oscar Bobb sending Josh King's pass from a corner low into the corner, left-footed, from inside the box.

sections.head: Bobb's winner
sections.pitch: Besides the goal that settled the match at Coventry, Oscar Bobb made four chances for his Fulham team-mates over its course.

sections.head: Leno's clean sheet
sections.pitch: Bernd Leno played the whole match without conceding a goal, and Coventry finished with nothing at all past the Fulham goalkeeper.
sections.stake: A free agent since The Raccoons let him go on Friday; seven points.

sections.head: Robinson unbreached
sections.pitch: Antonee Robinson was on for all of it with nothing conceded, and the league paid him one point for defending, of a possible two.
sections.stake: Cowthenbeef claimed him on Thursday, for six points.

reports.standfirst: Aston Villa beat Manchester City 2-1 through two Nicolas Jackson goals, handing the leaders a first defeat of the season.
reports.account: Jackson put Villa ahead in the 6th minute, taking John McGinn's pass inside the box and finishing right-footed into the top corner, and the lead lasted until after half-time. Erling Haaland levelled after 52 minutes, heading Iliman Ndiaye's set-piece cross into the bottom corner from close range. Jackson restored the lead after 60 minutes, Ibrahim Mbaye, on for Alysson, providing the pass for a right-footed finish from within the box into the middle of the goal.

sections.head: McGinn and Ndiaye assist
sections.pitch: John McGinn created four chances in all for Villa, the opener included. Iliman Ndiaye made one, and it was the one City converted.
sections.stake: Cowthenbeef has Ndiaye on the bench, for five points; its_ohi has McGinn, for five points against Cowthenbeef.

sections.head: Jackson's double
sections.pitch: Nicolas Jackson's two goals came from three shots, lifting him to four in the league this season. His defending also earned him a point, half the match's maximum.
sections.stake: The Truffle Pigs has him, for 11 points against If anyone can, Bannan can.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Jackson 11 (The Truffle Pigs), Haaland 6 (The Raccoons), McGinn 5 (its_ohi), Ndiaye 5 (Cowthenbeef)

reports.standfirst: An early Ezri Konsa goal set Arsenal on the way to a 2-0 win over Everton, their third in a row.
reports.account: Konsa struck in the 7th minute, meeting Viktor Gyökeres's corner pass at close range with a right-footed finish along the ground into the corner, and Everton trailed from there to half-time. Gabriel Magalhães headed Ben White's cross low into a corner from close in after 68 minutes. Everton's Vitalii Mykolenko went off injured with 16 minutes left.

sections.head: Gyökeres starts, creates opener
sections.pitch: Viktor Gyökeres made three chances on his first league start of the season, the assist for the opener the one that paid.
sections.stake: GlengarryHearts has him on the bench, for five points against The Raccoons.

sections.head: Lewis-Skelly's defending rewarded
sections.pitch: Myles Lewis-Skelly was rewarded with a single point for the defending he did, with two the most on offer from any one match.
sections.stake: A free agent since Cowthenbeef let him go on Wednesday; six points.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Magalhães 13 (Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza), Konsa 12 (its_ohi), White 9 (Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza), Raya 7 (If anyone can, Bannan can)

reports.standfirst: Chelsea lost 2-0 to Tottenham Hotspur after Cole Palmer was sent off.
reports.account: An injury ended James Maddison's match after 51 minutes. Spurs went in front with 13 minutes left through an own goal by Mike Penders. Palmer saw red for a second yellow card three minutes after the own goal. Seven minutes after the red card, Mathys Tel made it 2-0 with a right-footed shot from outside the box that went in low at the corner.

sections.head: Kinsky saves, Tel scores
sections.pitch: Antonín Kinsky produced four saves and kept Chelsea out from first whistle to last. Mathys Tel finished with one goal. Jorrel Hato was given one point by the league for what he did in defence, two being the ceiling for a match.
sections.stake: Kinsky, a free agent since Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza let him go on Wednesday, seven points; Tel, a free agent, six points; Hato, a free agent, seven points.

sections.head: Maddison hurt, nil kept
sections.pitch: Jan Paul van Hecke completed the full match with Spurs conceding nothing, and one point came his way for defending, out of two at most. James Maddison's injury is a possible groin problem.
sections.stake: domeitalycoach claimed van Hecke on Thursday, for seven points against AtleticoTimHortons; The Raccoons claimed Maddison on Wednesday, for one point.

keyStats.label: Clean sheet, full match
keyStats.value: van Hecke, Kinsky, Gray, van de Ven
